datasheet_identity.title: BZT52C2V0 THRU BZT52C75 SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES

extraction_notes: Power dissipation is 350 mW at Ta = 25 degC (p. 1, maximum ratings).
BZT52C7V5 row gives VZ min 7.13 V, nominal 7.5 V, max 7.88 V at IZT = 5 mA (p. 2).
Maximum zener impedance ZZT is 15 ohm at IZT = 5 mA; maximum knee impedance ZZK is 80 ohm at IZK = 1 mA (p. 2).
The temperature-coefficient row gives minimum 2.5 mV/degC and maximum 5.3 mV/degC at IZT (p. 2).
No junction-capacitance value or reverse-recovery time is published.
The curve is a family typical characteristic, not a part-specific measured trace.
